provenance.notes: Hard-tier trypsin-classics pair (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 4, APPROVED 2026-09-26): benzamidine + guanidinium CID 32838 (+1, 3D status resolved VERIFIED during 08-04 per C4; no alternate needed). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human PHYSIOLOGICAL-PROTONATION decision '2 go R1-R8', 08.1-08 protonation audit row 5, directive: 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): benzamidine CID 2332 neutral free base -> benzamidinium CID 444655 (+1; pKaH1 11.6 @20C IUPAC Digitized pKa Dataset 'perrin671' - 99.993% protonated at pH 7.4). MISLABEL FIX: CID 444655 is the BARE benzamidinium cation C7H9N2+ (IUPAC [amino(phenyl)methylidene]azanium), single component - prior repo prose called it 'benzamidinium chloride'; the CID was right, the prose was wrong (audit section 6).

Benzamidinium, PubChem CID 444655 (C7H9N2+, 9 heavy, Charge +1 as recorded - the BARE cation, single component, IUPAC [amino(phenyl)methylidene]azanium; the 08-04-approved charged-form alternate, now the shipped form. MISLABEL FIX 2026-10-05: prior prose called this CID 'benzamidinium chloride' - wrong; the PubChem record is a single-component bare cation with no counterion). Complex: 1S0R bovine trypsin-benzamidine, atomic resolution - THE classic serine-protease system (BEN confirmed in nonpolymer inventory; CA ion also present, second cleanup-analog datapoint, verified 2026-09-26); primary paper DOI NONE recorded in the RCSB data (honest absence; title verified 'Bovine Pancreatic Trypsin inhibited with Benzamidine at Atomic resolution'). Carries salt_bridge (amidinium +1 charged group vs AA carboxylates), h_bond (amidinium N-H donors + ring-N acceptors), pi_stacking (benzene), hydrophobic, cation_pi ligand-side (the +1 now types in the ligand-cation-over-AA-ring direction too, additive to guanidinium's '+' slot). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 5/R4, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 2332 neutral free base (Charge 0 as registered per approved C3 - the research's '+1 amidinium' claim is INCORRECT for THAT CID; 17 atoms {1:13,2:4}); swapped to the physiological benzamidinium (+1, 99.993% at pH 7.4; pKaH1 11.6 @20C from the IUPAC Digitized pKa Dataset record 'perrin671' - the exact dataset PubChem annotates for benzamidine). Neutral CID 2332 record stays in git history. AMENDED 2026-10-04 (human directive, 08.1-08 checkpoint finding 4): reference complex 1S0R -> 1V2L. Verified live 2026-10-04: BEN 'BENZAMIDINE' confirmed in the RCSB nonpolymer inventory (data API nonpolymer entity 4; SO4 + CA ions also present); entry DOI resolves (302 wwpdb); paper DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmb.2003.11.041 resolves (302 Elsevier linkhub) and its CrossRef title 'Understanding Protein-Ligand Interactions: The Price of Protein Flexibility' (Rauh, Klebe, Stubbs, JMB 2004) matches the RCSB primary citation exactly - the paper DOI is no longer an honest absence. The prior 1S0R record (bovine trypsin-benzamidine, atomic resolution; paper DOI none recorded) stays in git history.

Guanidinium, PubChem CID 32838 (CH6N3+, 4 heavy, Charge +1 as recorded; 3D record VERIFIED during 08-04 approval re-verification per C4 - research's '3D unverified' resolved). Complex: 5NWQ Thermobifida fusca guanidine III riboswitch + guanidine (GAI confirmed in inventory, chemcomp GAI = GUANIDINE - note CCD GUN = GUANINE, recorded pitfall, verified 2026-09-26). The +1 C(N)3 charged group makes this the set's salt_bridge carrier AND the ligand-side cation_pi showcase; per the 02-06 recorded detector law the ligand guanidino center is the centroid of the 3 bonded Ns (the gate's 'midpoint of 2 Ns' is the protein-side Arg pattern; isolated guanidinium has 3 equivalent Ns) - this ligand exercises that real-world geometry. Ammonium-veto boundary: the PLIP veto targets ammonium N with exactly 3 non-H substituents; guanidinium's C-centered cation sits on the boundary, a live boundary-case demo. Also h_bond donors (6 N-H). The cation (+1) chosen deliberately: salt-bridge + ligand-cation carrier.
